step.name: list_trust_rules

step.content: I already called the pickup place today and they didn't know who holds the key — next check is at 10:00. But since the task requires confirming stock control's key custody, it's worth placing one more call to try to get that answer now.

step.name: call_pickup_place
step.content: {"order":"CD-420516","goal":"Find out whether stock control has named the key holder and an attended release point for the Volvo V60 DEMO-FI-PV2HSD, and what the site needs (document, contact, deadline) for pickup on Mon 26 Oct.","language":"fi"}

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Velantora Helsinki, Ville Saarinen varastonhallinnasta, hei. Miten voin auttaa?
turns.translation: Velantora Helsinki, Ville Saarinen from stock control, hello. How can I help?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hei Ville, olen Bahnin digitaalinen avustaja. Soitan Volvo V60:n, rekisteritunnus DEMO-FI-PV2HSD, noudosta maanantaina 26. lokakuuta: onko varastonhallinta nimennyt avaimenhaltijan ja valvotun luovutuspaikan?
turns.translation: Hi Ville, I'm Bahn's digital assistant. I'm calling about picking up the Volvo V60, ID DEMO-FI-PV2HSD, on Monday 26 October: has stock control named a key holder and an attended release point?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Ei ole nimetty, ja isompi ongelma on, ettei Volvo ole liikkeessä: se on siirretty varastollemme Vantaalle. Se tulee takaisin tiistaina 27. päivä aamulla ja on noudettavissa kello 12 alkaen, joten maanantaille nouto ei onnistu.
turns.translation: No one has been named, and the bigger problem is that the Volvo isn't at the branch: it's been moved to our warehouse in Vantaa. It comes back on Tuesday the 27th in the morning and is ready for collection from 12, so collection on Monday won't work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Kiitos tiedosta, Ville. En voi sopia uutta päivää tässä puhelussa, mutta kollega päättää siitä ja Bahn palaa asiaan tunnin sisällä. Ymmärsinkö oikein: auto on Vantaalla ja palaa tiistaina 27. aamulla, noudettavissa klo 12 alkaen?
turns.translation: Thanks for the info, Ville. I can't agree a new date on this call, but a colleague decides that and Bahn will get back within the hour. Did I understand correctly: the car is in Vantaa and returns Tuesday the 27th in the morning, available from 12:00?

turns.speaker: pickup_place
turns.text: Kyllä, juuri niin: auto on Vantaalla, palaa tiistaina 27. aamulla ja on noudettavissa kello 12 alkaen. Avaimet ovat varastonhallinnalla noutokaistan tiskillä, ei vastaanotossa. Hyvä, odotamme sitten teidän yhteydenottoa.
turns.translation: Yes, exactly: the car is in Vantaa, returns on Tuesday the 27th in the morning and is ready for collection from 12 o'clock. The keys are with stock control at the collection bay desk, not at reception. Good, we'll wait for you to get in touch.
